title: Glowing trumpet
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- trumpet body - brass gold -->
  <rect x="35" y="48" width="40" height="12" rx="3" fill="#FFD54A"/>
  <rect x="35" y="48" width="40" height="4" rx="2" fill="#FFE88A"/>
  
  <!-- bell - wide flare on the right -->
  <path d="M75 48 L88 36 L88 72 L75 60 Z" fill="#FFC107"/>
  <path d="M75 48 L80 42 L80 54 L75 60 Z" fill="#FFE88A"/>
  <ellipse cx="88" cy="54" rx="4" ry="18" fill="#FFB300"/>
  <ellipse cx="88" cy="54" rx="2.5" ry="15" fill="#FFD54A"/>
  
  <!-- mouthpiece on the left -->
  <rect x="25" y="50" width="10" height="8" rx="2" fill="#FFC107"/>
  <rect x="25" y="50" width="10" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#FFE88A"/>
  <circle cx="24" cy="54" r="3" fill="#FFB300"/>
  
  <!-- valves - three vertical pipes on top -->
  <rect x="45" y="32" width="6" height="18" rx="2" fill="#FFD54A"/>
  <rect x="45" y="32" width="6" height="5" rx="2" fill="#FFE88A"/>
  <rect x="54" y="30" width="6" height="20" rx="2" fill="#FFC107"/>
  <rect x="54" y="30" width="6" height="5" rx="2" fill="#FFE88A"/>
  <rect x="63" y="34" width="6" height="16" rx="2" fill="#FFD54A"/>
  <rect x="63" y="34" width="6" height="5" rx="2" fill="#FFE88A"/>
  
  <!-- valve buttons - round caps -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="31" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#FFE88A"/>
  <ellipse cx="57" cy="29" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#FFD54A"/>
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="33" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#FFE88A"/>
  
  <!-- valve finger buttons - pearls -->
  <circle cx="48" cy="28" r="2" fill="#FFF8E1"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="26" r="2" fill="#FFF8E1"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="30" r="2" fill="#FFF8E1"/>
  
  <!-- valve connecting tubes -->
  <rect x="47" y="46" width="3" height="6" fill="#FFB300"/>
  <rect x="56" y="44" width="3" height="8" fill="#FFB300"/>
  <rect x="65" y="46" width="3" height="6" fill="#FFB300"/>
  
  <!-- water key / spit valve - small loop below -->
  <path d="M50 60 Q46 68 52 68 Q56 68 54 60" fill="none" stroke="#FFB300" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- glow aura around trumpet -->
  <ellipse cx="55" cy="54" rx="42" ry="24" fill="#FFE88A" opacity="0.25"/>
  <ellipse cx="88" cy="54" rx="12" ry="22" fill="#FFF8E1" opacity="0.3"/>
  <ellipse cx="24" cy="54" rx="6" ry="5" fill="#FFF8E1" opacity="0.3"/>
  
  <!-- sparkle highlights -->
  <path d="M90 38 L92 34 L94 38 L92 42 Z" fill="#FFF8E1" opacity="0.8"/>
  <path d="M20 46 L22 42 L24 46 L22 50 Z" fill="#FFF8E1" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="70" r="1.5" fill="#FFF8E1" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="32" cy="40" r="1.5" fill="#FFF8E1" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
